source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Texas AgriLife Extension, Expanded Nutrition Program - Hidalgo County

steps.instruction: Mix 3 cups of oatmeal, 1/2 cup of coconut and 1 cup of pecans in a large bowl.
Mix in 1/4 cup of honey, 1/4 cup of liquid margarine and 1 1/2 teaspoons of cinnamon.
Spread the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking pan.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 25 to thirty minutes, until golden brown. Stir every five minutes.

steps.instruction: Store the granola in a tightly covered container.
